context: A married couple reviews household debt and savings
purpose: Teach: 現金/値上げ/返済/公団/商標/稼ぐ/職務/突入

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、ちょっとローン返済の表を見てほしいんだけど。
lines.en: Hey, I want you to look at the loan repayment chart.
lines.style: Calm but slightly anxious wife opening a serious financial discussion

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、住宅公団のやつだろ？今月分はもう振り込んだよ。
lines.en: Ah, the housing public corporation one? I already transferred this month's payment.
lines.style: Reassuring husband, matter-of-fact tone, slightly tired after work

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それがね、来月から料金値上げの通知が来てて、家計が厳しくなりそうなの。
lines.en: The thing is, a notice came about a price increase starting next month, and the budget will get tight.
lines.style: Worried wife sharing bad news softly, looking for a plan

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: マジか…じゃあ当面は現金払いを増やして、カードの使用は抑えよう。
lines.en: Seriously? Then for now let's increase cash payments and cut down card use.
lines.style: Husband shifting into problem-solving mode, practical and decisive

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、私も副業で稼ぐ時間を少し増やそうかなって考えてるの。
lines.en: Yeah, I was thinking I might increase the time I spend earning from my side job.
lines.style: Wife offering a constructive idea, tentative but determined

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 無理すんなよ。うちの会社、職務手当が少し上がるって話もあるしさ。
lines.en: Don't push yourself. At my company, there's talk the job duty allowance will go up a bit too.
lines.style: Caring husband offering gentle reassurance and hopeful work news

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほんと？じゃあその分、ボーナスも全部貯金に回せたら助かるね。
lines.en: Really? Then if we can put all of the bonus into savings too, that would really help.
lines.style: Wife brightening up, calculating and hopeful about the future

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、うちの商標が他社にも使われ始めて、ライセンス料も入る予定だしな。
lines.en: Yeah, our company's trademark is starting to be used by other firms, and licensing fees should come in too.
lines.style: Husband sharing a small piece of work news with quiet optimism

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: すごい。じゃあ返済計画も最終局面に突入って感じだね。
lines.en: Amazing. So our repayment plan is entering its final phase, isn't it.
lines.style: Wife sounding relieved and proud, closing the talk on a confident note
